- [Polarex.Support.Client](https://polarex.hexdocs.pm/Polarex.Support.Client.md): This module is not automatically generated.
It is manually created to provide a Req request client for the Polar API.

- [Polarex.Support.Translator](https://polarex.hexdocs.pm/Polarex.Support.Translator.md): This module's purpose is to automatically translate each response type from the generated API.
It exposes a single function called `translate` that receives the type and the value to parse.
